newsitem.title: USA: U.S. JET FUEL PRICES WEAKEN TRACKING NYMEX DROP.
newsitem.headline: U.S. JET FUEL PRICES WEAKEN TRACKING NYMEX DROP.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices slid lower, tracking the drop on the NYMEX, while differentials showed little movement.
On the NYMEX, September heating oil futures shed 1.34 cents to settle at 56.98 cents a gallon.
U.S. Gulf mpt 54-grade jet fuel differentials were seen near 0.65 cent over the NYMEX price, according to market watchers, though activity appeared fairly subdued.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet fuel continued to hover near 3.25 cents over the September NYMEX, according to players, with low sulphur 55-grade jet fuel at about 3.75 cents over the NYMEX.
-- Matt Daily, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
